Book and check, in order

Risks

What could change the plan

Bridges
Check WSDOT a week out
  • Hood Canal Bridge: ship openings can hold traffic 30 minutes or more.
  • Tacoma Narrows: toll heading to Tacoma, $4.50 with a pass.
Closures
2026 status
  • Hurricane Ridge: no water or day lodge. Utility work in 2026.
  • Five Mile Drive: the outer loop has been closed to cars since 2022.
Crowds
Go early
  • Hurricane Ridge: peak 10:00 to 14:00, entry can be metered.
  • Paradise: the lot fills by 09:00 to 10:00.

Day by day

Order of the two big blocks
Sat 17 JulFestival3h00 driving
Land 08:45, then straight to the lavender.
  • Car at Sea-Tac, then ~2h30 to Sequim via the Tacoma Narrows. Aim for 13:30 to 14:00.
  • Festival in the Park, free, to 19:00. Lots fill by 11:00, so use church lots or street parking.
  • Farms: Jardin du Soleil ($10 to $15, to 18:00), Victor's (to 19:00, free barn dance).
  • The farmers market closes at 14:00. Past years ran to 17:00. Check in June.
Sun 18 JulNature2h25 driving
Hurricane Ridge early, then the lavender again.
  • Leave Port Angeles 06:45. On the ridge by 07:30, off by 10:30.
  • Hurricane Hill, 3.2 mi, 2 to 2.5 hours. Carry water: none on the ridge.
  • Sequim by 11:45: Sunday market (9:00 to 15:00 in past years) and the farms you skipped.
  • Festival runs to 17:00. Back in Port Angeles by 17:30.
Mon 19 JulNature5h15 driving
Two walks, then the long drive to Tacoma.
  • Marymere Falls 08:15, 1.8 mi. Sol Duc Falls by 10:30, 1.6 mi. Leave Sol Duc by 12:30.
  • Via Port Angeles, SR-3 and SR-16, about 3h50. Fuel and lunch in Port Angeles.
  • Dinner on Ruston Way, then the waterfront path. Sunset is about 21:00.
Tue 20 JulTravel3h35 driving
Point Defiance, then the long drive to Port Angeles.
  • Leave Eatonville 07:30. Point Defiance at about 08:45: Owen Beach and the free gardens.
  • Outer Five Mile Drive is closed to cars. Leave by 11:30.
  • Then about 2h30 via the Narrows (toll $4.50 with a pass) and the Hood Canal Bridge.
  • Dinner in Port Angeles. Hurricane Ridge is tomorrow.
Wed 21 JulNature2h30 driving
Hurricane Ridge early, then Lake Crescent.
  • Leave Port Angeles 06:45. On the ridge by 07:30, off by 10:30.
  • Hurricane Hill, 3.2 mi, 2 to 2.5 hours. Carry water: none on the ridge.
  • Lunch at Lake Crescent Lodge, then a swim at Barnes Point if it is warm.
  • Back in Port Angeles by 16:30.
Thu 22 JulNature2h50 driving
Marymere Falls and Sol Duc Falls.
  • Marymere Falls 08:15, 1.8 mi. Sol Duc Falls by 10:30, 1.6 mi.
  • Optional soak at Sol Duc Hot Springs. Back in Port Angeles by 16:00.

Where to stay

Sat–Sun · 2 nights
Port Angeles

Sequim is 25 min east. Hurricane Ridge is 45 min up.

Book early: Festival rooms near Sequim typically sell out by spring.

Mon · 1 night
Tacoma, at Point Ruston

4 min from Point Defiance. The waterfront path is at the door.

BOOK Silver Cloud Point Ruston: valet parking only, about $38 a night. Pick a refundable rate.

Or: Hotel Murano, downtown, 18 min from the park.

Tue–Thu · 3 nights
Port Angeles

Hurricane Ridge is 45 min up. Sol Duc is 1h20 west.

Know before you go

  • Hurricane Ridge has no water or day lodge. Carry food and water.
  • Olympic is $30 a vehicle, valid 7 days.

Day by day

Order of the two big blocks
Tue 20 JulTravel1h55 driving
Point Defiance, the outlets, dinner on the way.
  • Point Defiance by 08:30. Outer Five Mile Drive is closed to cars: drive the inner loop.
  • Owen Beach, the free gardens, Narrows viewpoints. Leave by 12:00.
  • Outlet Collection Seattle, Auburn, 35 min on. Likely open 11:00 to 20:00. Leave by 17:30.
  • Dinner in Graham, Sumner or Eatonville (Cruiser Cafe to 20:00). Check in by 20:30.
Wed 21 JulNature1h25 driving
Paradise, day one of two.
  • Leave Eatonville by 06:00. In the park before 07:00, at Paradise before 09:00.
  • Skyline Trail loop MUST-SEE, 5.7 mi, on the clearer day. Poles and boots: some snow in July.
  • Check in to Paradise Inn. Dinner is served to 20:30.
Thu 22 JulNature1h25 driving
Paradise, day two, then Eatonville.
  • Check out. Bags stay in the car. Comet Falls by 08:00: only 16 parking spaces.
  • Then what day one missed: Skyline, Nisqually Vista, Reflection Lakes.
  • Leave by 18:00 to reach Eatonville before dark.
Sat 17 JulArrival1h10 driving
Land 08:45, then an easy first day at Eatonville.
  • Car at Sea-Tac, then about 1h15 to Eatonville.
  • Northwest Trek Wildlife Park, open 9:30 to 17:00 in summer 2026. Allow 3 hours.
  • Early dinner and bed. Sunday starts at 06:00.
Sun 18 JulNature1h25 driving
Paradise, day one of two.
  • Leave Eatonville by 06:00. In the park before 07:00, at Paradise before 09:00.
  • Skyline Trail loop MUST-SEE, 5.7 mi, on the clearer day. Poles and boots: some snow in July.
  • Check in to Paradise Inn. Dinner is served to 20:30.
Mon 19 JulNature1h25 driving
Paradise, day two, then Eatonville.
  • Check out. Bags stay in the car. Comet Falls by 08:00: only 16 parking spaces.
  • Then what day one missed: Skyline, Nisqually Vista, Reflection Lakes.
  • Leave by 18:00 to reach Eatonville before dark.

Where to stay

Tue · 1 night
Eatonville, on the way in

On your route. The next day starts early: 45 min to the gate.

CALL Mill Village Motel: 32 rooms, mixed reviews. Confirm a late check-in.

Closer: Ashford saves 35 min the next morning but costs 40 min on Friday.

Wed · 1 night
Paradise, inside the park

The next day starts at the trailhead, with no drive and no queue.

BOOK THIS Paradise Inn: 121 rooms, about US$300 to $550 in peak season.

Fallback: National Park Inn, Longmire (25 rooms), then Ashford.

Thu · 1 night
Eatonville, on the way out

About 1h20 to Seattle, against 2h from Ashford.

Or: Stay in Ashford if you want the sunset at Paradise.

Sat · 1 night
Eatonville

An easy first night, 1h15 from the airport.

CALL Mill Village Motel: 32 rooms, mixed reviews. Confirm a late check-in.

Sun · 1 night
Paradise, inside the park

The next day starts at the trailhead, with no drive and no queue.

BOOK THIS Paradise Inn: 121 rooms, about US$300 to $550 in peak season.

Fallback: National Park Inn, Longmire (25 rooms), then Ashford.

Mon · 1 night
Eatonville, on the way out

The Narrows route to Port Angeles starts here on Tuesday.

Know before you go

  • Wednesday or Sunday starts early: 45 min to the gate, 1h20 to Paradise.
  • Rainier is $30 a vehicle, valid 7 days.
  • No timed entry in 2026. Recheck in spring 2027.

Day by day

Order of the two big blocks
Fri 23 JulArrival1h20 driving
Eatonville to the city, then Pike Place.
  • Leave Eatonville by 08:30. Return the car at Sea-Tac, then Link to Westlake.
  • Pike Place Market MUST-SEE this afternoon. For it quiet, go back before 09:00 on Saturday.
  • Waterfront and the Great Wheel. Kerry Park an hour before sunset.
Fri 23 JulArrival3h10 driving
Port Angeles to the city, then Pike Place.
  • Leave Port Angeles by 07:30. About 3h by road via the Narrows.
  • Ferries cannot be reserved and often fill in summer. Return the car at Sea-Tac, then Link to Westlake.
  • Pike Place Market MUST-SEE this afternoon. Kerry Park an hour before sunset.
Sat 24 JulFestival
Seattle Center and the festivals, or Ballard.
  • Bite of Seattle: 300+ vendors in 2026, beside the Space Needle and MoPOP.
  • Or Ballard: the Locks, then Ballard Avenue shops and breweries.
  • Torchlight Parade is likely Jul 31, not tonight. Recheck seafair.org in spring.
Sun 25 JulTravel
Fremont Sunday Market, then the 15:34 to Calgary.
  • Fremont Sunday Market at 10:00. It only runs on Sundays.
  • Link to Sea-Tac at ~12:15. At the airport by 13:30.
  • Alaska SEA 15:34 to YYC 18:10. Booked.

Where to stay

Fri–Sun · 2 nights
Downtown, Pike Place to Belltown

Car-free. Walk to Pike Place. Link runs to Sea-Tac.

Or: Capitol Hill, on Link, with the best food and nightlife.

Hours and prices are 2026 figures. Recheck in spring 2027.
